enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.description: A goblin springs out from behind a broken pillar, snarling!
enemies.successText: Nice hit! The goblin stumbles back.
enemies.failText: It ducks and swipes back with grubby claws.

enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.description: Another goblin pops out of the shadows, chittering away!
enemies.successText: Bullseye — it bounces off the ruined wall!
enemies.failText: Chomp! Those little teeth are sharper than they look.
